## Checklist

- [ ] `mise run test` passes
- [ ] `mise run lint:prose` and `mise run lint:md` are clean
- [ ] If a rule changed: ran `mise run expected:update` and reviewed the diff by hand
- [ ] If a rule's `level` or first `message` line changed: ran `mise run readme:update`
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
